answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 48130 Country: India Title: Salah Question: We would like to know when we are in continuous travel for 15 days or more, especially in the month of Ramadan, when we pray Maghrib and Isha together whether tarawih prayer also can be performed along with the combined prayer. Please give Fatwa on this subject matter. Answer ID: 48130 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1381/927/L=11/1434) It is not lawful to combine two salahs in a journey and offer them together. Each salah should be offered in its time. If two salahs are to be performed together then its method is that Maghrib is offered in its last time and Isha is offered in its starting time, then tarawih should be offered as per the capacity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
